name: EPIC 249208077
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 9.9 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249208077 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.908813 (16th-84th percentiles 9.74342-10.111675), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,993 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.84 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,774 K at its surface.
